review.verdict: Third on Sapphiron, Shadow Fissure on Kel'Thuzad
review.summary: Third on Sapphiron (203k), sixth on Heigan. Average 44 against your usual 63, with Maexxna (19th) and Gothik (20th) low. Full consumables all night. On the Kel'Thuzad wipe you stood on a Shadow Fissure at 2:03.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: Zanza, food, Mongoose, Juju Power, Winterfall and flask on all 14.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Void Blast at 2:03 on the wipe.

review.verdict: Second healer on Loatheb
review.summary: Second of the healers on Loatheb, fourth on Patchwerk. 14 dispels. 12th on Grobbulus and Heigan.

review.verdict: First healer on nine bosses, and Patchwerk is still the one you skip
review.summary: First of the healers on Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina, Maexxna, Grobbulus, Thaddius, Gothik, the Horsemen, Noth and Kel'Thuzad. Annoying. Then Patchwerk, the one fight that is nothing but healing: 8th of 13 with 68% overheal. On 21 Oct you were last there, so this is progress, of a sort. Heigan 6th, Loatheb 10th. Kreeg's Stout Beatdown and Gordok Green Grog on all 14 pulls, Spirit of Zanza on none. Four Dark Runes and none of them killed you this time, which for you counts as growth.

good.title: Healing
good.text: First of the healers on nine bosses.

fix.title: Patchwerk
fix.text: 8th of 13 healers, 68% overheal, on the one pure healing fight.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Spirit of Zanza on 0 of 14 pulls. The drinks were on all 14.

review.verdict: Main tank on eleven bosses and never died
review.summary: First of the tanks on Faerlina, Maexxna, Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Gluth, Razuvious (parse 94), Noth, Heigan, Loatheb, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad. You lived through the whole night, the Kel'Thuzad wipe included, despite five Chains. The one wrong-side polarity hit on Thaddius was yours.

good.title: Tanking
good.text: First of the tanks on eleven bosses.

fix.title: Thaddius
fix.text: The raid's one wrong-side polarity hit.

review.verdict: Parse 91 on Thaddius, four trash deaths
review.summary: Parse 91 on Thaddius, 85 on Patchwerk, 83 on Noth, second on Gothik and the Horsemen. 10 Life Drains, 2 curses and 6 interrupts. Four trash deaths, four Rain of Fire hits on Faerlina (the most), and Kel'Thuzad's melee killed you at 1:21 on the wipe.

fix.title: Faerlina
fix.text: 4 Rain of Fire hits, the most.

review.verdict: First on Razuvious, second on Gluth, Heigan and Loatheb
review.summary: First on Razuvious, second on Gluth, Heigan and Loatheb, third on Anub'Rekhan, and tanked the Horsemen to a 90. Four interrupts. Five Holy Wrath hits on the Horsemen, the most.

review.verdict: First on Gothik and Heigan, five curses on Noth
review.summary: The most damage on Gothik and Heigan, five curses removed on Noth (the most) and 7 Life Drains. Disrupting Shout killed you on Razuvious at 0:51, the only raider it hit. Low on Grobbulus (last), Gluth and Loatheb. A trash death to a Lightning Totem.

fix.title: Razuvious
fix.text: The only raider hit by Disrupting Shout, dead at 0:51.

review.verdict: 17 interrupts and parse 96 on Anub'Rekhan and the Horsemen
review.summary: 17 interrupts, the most in the raid: 8 of Kel'Thuzad's Frostbolts, 6 Shadow Bolt Volleys, 3 Slime Bolts. Parse 96 on Anub'Rekhan and the Horsemen, 92 on Grobbulus, 91 on Faerlina, average 82 against your usual 63. Third on Faerlina, Gothik, the Horsemen and Noth. Heigan (16th) was the one quiet boss.

review.verdict: Top four on six bosses
review.summary: Second on Maexxna, third on Gluth and Loatheb, fourth on Faerlina, Noth and Sapphiron. Average 58, your usual. Two Impales and a Void Zone. Kel'Thuzad's melee killed you at 3:20 on the wipe.

review.verdict: 52 dispels, 45 of them Veil of Shadow
review.summary: 52 dispels (45 Veil of Shadow), 4 curses on Noth, 7 Innervates and 245 Faerie Fires. Fifth of the healers on Patchwerk and the Horsemen. Frost Aura killed you on Sapphiron at 2:11, and a Necro Stalker on trash.

review.verdict: Caught by Frost Breath on Sapphiron
review.summary: Fifth on Loatheb, sixth on Patchwerk, parse 79 on the Horsemen. Average 47 against your usual 61. The first Frost Breath on Sapphiron killed you at 1:15. Three Rain of Fire hits on Faerlina.

review.verdict: 202 Sunders, two trash deaths
review.summary: Eighth on Razuvious and Faerlina, 202 Sunders, 4 Frostbolts kicked. Average 43 against your usual 55: 22nd on Maexxna, 24th on Heigan, 20th on Noth. Two trash deaths.

review.verdict: 39 Hateful Strikes after Macharius fell
review.summary: Macharius went down at 0:39 on Patchwerk and you took 39 of the 49 Hateful Strikes from there, nobody else dying. Tanked Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina, Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Thaddius, Razuvious, Gothik, the Horsemen and Noth. 131 Demoralizing Shouts and the most consumables of any tank. Frost Blast took you, Mercîless and Foggiie together at 1:04 on the Kel'Thuzad wipe.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Frost Blast at 1:04 with Mercîless and Foggiie inside 10 yards.

51114.text: Frost Blast at 1:04 on the wipe.

review.verdict: 15 interrupts, 9 of them Frostbolts
review.summary: 15 interrupts, second in the raid: 9 Frostbolts and 5 Shadow Bolt Volleys. 60 Expose Armors. Sixth on Maexxna, parse 81 on Anub'Rekhan. Average 59 against your usual 71, with Thaddius (20th) the low point.

review.verdict: Second healer on Gluth and Gothik, 13 Power Infusions
review.summary: Second of the healers on Gluth and Gothik, third on Anub'Rekhan and Faerlina. 13 Power Infusions and 5 Shackles on the Kel'Thuzad kill. Frost Blast took you with Fenhir and Mercîless at 1:04 on the wipe. Heigan 11th.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Frost Blast at 1:05 on the wipe, standing inside 10 yards of two others.

review.verdict: First on Faerlina and Noth, second on Thaddius and Razuvious
review.summary: First on Faerlina and Noth, second on Thaddius, Razuvious and Sapphiron, third on Patchwerk and Grobbulus. Average 69. Full consumables, no deaths until the Kel'Thuzad wipe.

review.verdict: First on Sapphiron, first death of the Kel'Thuzad wipe
review.summary: The most damage on Sapphiron (217k, parse 72), fifth on Anub'Rekhan, seventh on Razuvious, Heigan and Loatheb. Tanked Faerlina, Gothik and the Horsemen. On the Kel'Thuzad wipe you stood on a Shadow Fissure and died at 0:18, the first death of the pull.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Void Blast at 0:18 on the wipe. Move off the fissure.

51114.text: Shadow Fissure at 0:18 on the wipe.

review.verdict: Average parse 41, against your usual 76
review.summary: Fifth on Thaddius. After that the night slipped: 19th of 20 on the Horsemen, 21st on Noth, 22nd on Loatheb, average 41 against your usual 76. Three Frostbolts kicked, alive at the end of the Kel'Thuzad wipe.

good.title: Kel'Thuzad
good.text: Alive at the end of the wipe.

review.verdict: Tanked Anub'Rekhan to a 93, died early on Patchwerk
review.summary: First of the tanks on Anub'Rekhan (parse 93) and Gothik, tanked Faerlina, Thaddius and Kel'Thuzad. On Patchwerk a Hateful Strike killed you at 0:39 from 42% health, after 10 soaked. 207 Sunders. Low damage when off tank (23rd on Noth).

review.verdict: Sixth on the Horsemen, last on Gluth and Gothik
review.summary: Fifth on Patchwerk, sixth on the Horsemen (parse 82), second on damage during the Kel'Thuzad wipe. Last on Gluth (272/s) and on Gothik, where a Spectral Horse killed you at 2:42. Frost Blast on the Kel'Thuzad wipe at 1:04.

review.verdict: First healer on Patchwerk, two Void Zone hits
review.summary: First of the healers on Patchwerk (521 HPS), third on Heigan. 14 dispels. Two Void Zone hits on the Horsemen, and one killed you at 3:23. Your Blessing of Sacrifice killed you on the Kel'Thuzad wipe.

review.verdict: 23 Power Infusions, first healer on Gluth and Loatheb
review.summary: 23 Power Infusions, the most. First of the healers on Gluth and Loatheb, second on Faerlina, Thaddius, the Horsemen and Kel'Thuzad. Razuvious went cleanly this time, two controls and one Disrupting Shout hit in the raid. 8 Shackles over the two Kel'Thuzad pulls. Noth was the low point: last of 13.

good.title: Razuvious
good.text: 2 Understudies controlled, one Shout hit in the raid.

review.verdict: 70 dispels and alive until the Kel'Thuzad wipe
review.summary: 70 dispels, the most: 42 Veil of Shadow, 6 poisons on Faerlina, 9 Life Drains, the one Necrotic Poison on Maexxna, 3 curses on Noth. 263 Faerie Fires, 8 Innervates. No deaths until the Guardians on the Kel'Thuzad wipe. Healing sat last on five bosses, which is the cost of that dispel load.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last of the healers on five bosses.

review.verdict: First on Maexxna and Gluth, killed by Thaddius at 2:24
review.summary: First on Maexxna and Gluth, fourth on Grobbulus. 60 dispels (43 Veil of Shadow, 14 Life Drains). On Thaddius you died to his melee at 2:24, most likely the threat of the Ignite the log credits to you there. Last on the Horsemen, 23rd on Sapphiron and Loatheb.

review.verdict: Second healer on Noth, alive through the Kel'Thuzad wipe
review.summary: Second of the healers on Noth, third on Loatheb, 6 poisons cleansed on Faerlina. One of four people still alive when the Kel'Thuzad wipe ended. Last of the healers on Faerlina, 12th on Anub'Rekhan.

good.title: Kel'Thuzad
good.text: Alive at the end of the wipe.

review.verdict: Sixth on Razuvious, seven interrupts
review.summary: Sixth on Razuvious (parse 80), seventh on Gluth. Seven interrupts, six of them Frostbolts. Average 47 against your usual 59. Two Impales and two Blizzards.

review.verdict: Last healer on three bosses
review.summary: 25 dispels, 9 of them Cripple. Healing was at the bottom: last of the healers on Grobbulus and Thaddius, nothing on Heigan, 12th on Gluth, Gothik and Noth. A trash death to a Necro Stalker.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last on Grobbulus and Thaddius, none on Heigan.

review.verdict: All five Mutating Injections dispelled
review.summary: Every Mutating Injection on Grobbulus was yours, 5 of 5, plus 6 Decrepit Fevers. 31 dispels. Second of the healers on Heigan, third on Noth. 12th on Maexxna, Patchwerk and Sapphiron.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: 12th of 13 on Maexxna, Patchwerk and Sapphiron.

review.verdict: Second on Faerlina, eight interrupts
review.summary: Second on Faerlina (parse 83), third on Heigan, fifth on Grobbulus, the Horsemen and Noth. Eight interrupts. Chill killed you on Sapphiron at 1:54, and two poison cloud hits on Grobbulus were the most.

review.verdict: 359 Sunders, two Kel'Thuzad deaths
review.summary: First of the tanks on Thaddius, tanked Faerlina, Gothik, the Horsemen (parse 77) and Noth. 359 Sunders, the most, and 5 interrupts. Void Blast on the Kel'Thuzad wipe at 4:10, a Guardian on the kill at 2:44. Low damage off tank: 20th on Grobbulus, 24th on Kel'Thuzad.

review.verdict: 42 dispels, first healer on Heigan
review.summary: 42 dispels, the most of the paladins. First of the healers on Heigan, second on Patchwerk. Last on Gluth (47 HPS). Two trash deaths.

review.verdict: Parse 98 on Gluth, killed by Loatheb at 0:22
review.summary: 318 Curses of Recklessness and big parses: 98 on Gluth, 97 on Grobbulus, 96 on Heigan, 94 on the Horsemen. Average 74, up from 67. On Loatheb his melee killed you at 0:22, the only death of the fight. No damage on Noth in the log.

review.verdict: Curse of the Elements all night, parse 65 against a usual 45
review.summary: 354 Curses of the Elements and an average parse of 65, well over your usual 45: 88 on the Horsemen, 84 on Thaddius, 79 on Patchwerk. By place you were last on Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina and Maexxna.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: Last on Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina and Maexxna.

review.verdict: All three Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth, parse 81 average
review.summary: The raid's only Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth, three of them. Parse 95 on Faerlina, 93 on the Horsemen, 92 on Patchwerk and Heigan, average 81. Last on Thaddius by place (941/s).

good.title: Gluth
good.text: 3 Tranquilizing Shots, the raid's only ones.

review.verdict: 24 Life Drains, the most, and four trash deaths
review.summary: 24 Life Drains on Sapphiron, the most in the raid, plus 27 Veil of Shadows and 4 curses. Damage was low: last on Sapphiron, 25th on Maexxna, 24th on Grobbulus. Four trash deaths.

review.verdict: First on the Horsemen, second on three bosses
review.summary: First on the Horsemen (parse 94), second on Anub'Rekhan, Patchwerk and Grobbulus, third on Maexxna and Thaddius. Blaumeux's Mark killed you at 3:35, eight seconds before the kill. 16 Stratholme Holy Waters. Two Rain of Fire hits and two Blizzards.

51121.text: First on damage, died to a Mark at 3:35.

review.verdict: First on Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus and Loatheb
review.summary: First on Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus and Loatheb, second on Noth, third on Razuvious, and tanked the Horsemen to a 91. Seven interrupts. One of four people alive at the end of the Kel'Thuzad wipe. Heigan was empty (104/s, last) and Chill got you on Sapphiron at 1:48.

review.verdict: In for two bosses
review.summary: Anub'Rekhan and Faerlina, 17th on both, then gone from the log.

review.verdict: 11 interrupts, seven of them Frostbolts
review.summary: 11 interrupts, third in the raid. Seventh on Sapphiron, parse 76 on Faerlina and 78 on the Horsemen. Three Blizzard hits on Sapphiron, the most.

review.verdict: 198k healing on Sapphiron and 8 shackles on the kill
review.summary: First of the healers on Sapphiron (198k), second on Anub'Rekhan, Maexxna and Grobbulus, third on Gothik and the Horsemen. 8 Shackles on the Kel'Thuzad kill, the most. Patchwerk again: last of 13 healers.

fix.title: Trash
fix.text: Poison Charge from a Necro Stalker.

review.verdict: 15 Power Infusions and a clean Razuvious
review.summary: 15 Power Infusions, 2 Worshippers on Faerlina and 2 Understudies on Razuvious, where only one raider took a Disrupting Shout. Third of the healers on Maexxna, Patchwerk, Thaddius and Kel'Thuzad. Five Shackles over the Kel'Thuzad pulls. The first Frost Breath on Sapphiron killed you at 1:15.
